question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The film actor and director were accused of indulging in __nepotism__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"nepotism"** means the practice among those with power or influence of favoring relatives or friends, especially by giving them jobs. (कुटुम्बपक्षपात)

 
 
• **Example: **Many criticized the company for its** nepotism**, as several top positions were filled by family members of the board.
 
 
 
• **"Impartiality"** refers to the equal and fair treatment of all rivals or disputants; it means not being biased or showing favoritism. (निष्पक्षता)
 
 
• **Example: **The judge was known for his **impartiality**, ensuring that all cases were judged fairly and without bias.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'nepotism'** is **'impartiality'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inclination **(झुकाव): A tendency to act or feel a certain way.

 
 
• **Example:** His inclination towards art was evident from a young age.
 
 
 
• **Partiality **(पक्षपात): Unfair bias in favor of one thing or person compared with another.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher's partiality towards certain students was obvious.
 
 
 
• **Favouritism **(पक्षपात): The practice of giving unfair preferential treatment to one person or group.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager's favouritism created a rift among the team members.
